gameplayCandidate.policy: paired BP mechanics classes under gameplay roots, including DLC/Patch branches
gameplayCandidate.boundary: Selected gameplay mechanics candidates, not whole-game coverage.

structural.boundary: Filtering ratio, not quality; retained facts include synthetic empty-CDO observations, which are not parsed properties.

differenceTaxonomy.definition: Accepted exact entity/property mapping compatible with the closure gates.
Equivalent names requiring an explicit alias; closure is a separate axis.
A nested value or reference needs normalization, not merely renaming.
Observed retained field without a Gap property; not a whole-game inventory.
Expected property has no current direct evidence; absence is not proven.
A raw value exists but its effective meaning is unresolved.
Static evidence does not determine final runtime/scaled values.
Observation, measurement or controlled interaction remains necessary.
A demonstrated property-specific parser limitation blocks evidence.
Empty declared CDO leaves inherited/native/reference storage unresolved.
Root-label version claim cannot establish version history.
Conflicting public sources or direct evidence require reconciliation.
A software implementation decision remains required.
A product objective decision remains required.
No exact canonical entity or authoritative alias was resolved.
No match under current parser + candidate + semantic-rule scope.
